meta.name: amcards-automation
meta.description: Automate Amcards tasks via Rube MCP (Composio). Always search tools first for current schemas.

copy.tagline: 自动执行 Amcards 的重复操作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常需要批量处理 Amcards 上的工作。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently perform repetitive Amcards operations.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过 Rube MCP 自动操作 Amcards，如创建卡片、更新列表等。执行前会先搜索可用工具并检查连接状态。
howto.when: 当你要求处理 Amcards 相关任务（如管理卡片、列表等）时触发。

say.text: 帮我在 Amcards 中创建一张新卡片，标题是‘周报’
say.note: Claude 会搜索工具并执行创建

say.text: 把 Amcards 列表‘待办’中的第一项移到‘进行中’
say.note: Claude 会更新列表项状态

say.text: 列出 Amcards 中所有标签为‘重要’的卡片
say.note: Claude 会查询并返回结果

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can automate Amcards tasks via Rube MCP, such as creating cards, updating lists, etc. It always searches for tools and checks connection before execution.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for Amcards-related operations (e.g., managing cards, lists).

say_en.text: Create a new Amcards card titled 'Weekly Report'
say_en.note: Claude will search tools and execute creation

say_en.text: Move the first item in Amcards list 'To Do' to 'In Progress'
say_en.note: Claude will update list item status

say_en.text: List all Amcards cards tagged as 'Important'
say_en.note: Claude will query and return results
